label: Knowledge Workbench
headline: Overview route is live; knowledge delivery remains module-gated
summary: This overview is a truthful landing surface for the Knowledge Workbench. KW-01 is route-live, KW-02 to KW-04 have published downstream contracts, and KW-05 is now contract-ready instead of architecture-blocked.

packet_family.note: KW-01 is ready, downstream Knowledge modules all have published contracts, and KW-05 now joins the implementation lane as contract-ready.

modules.label: Institutional Memory
modules.summary: Browse/list/detail projection published. Identity, lifecycle state machine, filter rail, and degradation semantics are all locked via docs/bff/KW-01-institutional-memory.md.
modules.next_gate: KW-02 note ownership and attachment contract must be published before Research Notes UI can open.

modules.label: Research Notes
modules.summary: Research Notes contract is published and ratified. Remaining work is BFF implementation of the note create/list/detail route family.
modules.next_gate: Implement the published KW-02 routes and attachment taxonomy in the BFF before opening the production UI.

modules.label: Evidence Refs
modules.summary: Evidence Refs contract is published and ratified. Remaining work is BFF implementation of the evidence browse/detail routes and resolved-link projection.
modules.next_gate: Implement the published KW-03 evidence routes so downstream insight and citation surfaces can rely on live resolved links.

modules.label: Insight Cards
modules.summary: Insight Cards contract is published and ratified. Remaining work is BFF implementation of aggregation/detail routes using the published filter taxonomy.
modules.next_gate: Implement the published KW-04 aggregation and detail routes after KW-02 and KW-03 are live upstream inputs.

modules.label: Strategy Spec
modules.summary: Strategy Spec contract is now published and ratified. Remaining work is BFF implementation of the browse/detail/history/compare route family against the versioned spec model.
modules.next_gate: Implement the published KW-05 routes against the ratified version identity, lifecycle, ancestry, and compare semantics.

support_refs.label: KW-01 Institutional Memory BFF Contract
support_refs.note: Canonical list/detail routes, lifecycle state machine, filter rail, degradation semantics, and identity contract for the Institutional Memory browse module.

support_refs.label: Memory Layer Design Note
support_refs.note: Canonical Memory Plane split and retrieval-facade rules.

support_refs.label: InstitutionalMemoryEntry schema
support_refs.note: Canonical shared-memory object shape; not a workbench browse contract.

support_refs.label: StrategySpec schema
support_refs.note: Canonical StrategySpec object schema; version browsing, ancestry, lifecycle, and compare semantics are now ratified in docs/bff/KW-05-strategy-spec.md.

support_refs.label: Memory retrieval facade
support_refs.note: Session-facing retrieval API; not a substitute for workbench list/detail surfaces.

next_steps: KW-01 Institutional Memory is ready — Lovable may open the browse/detail UI task against docs/bff/KW-01-institutional-memory.md.
Implement KW-02 Research Notes routes and attachment taxonomy in the BFF.
Implement KW-03 Evidence Refs and KW-04 Insight Cards on top of the published contracts.
Implement the published KW-05 Strategy Spec routes against the ratified version model before opening the production UI.
Keep the Knowledge Workbench payload-owned; do not synthesize registry joins from raw schemas in the browser.
Use this overview to track which module is next, not to imply that Insight Cards or Strategy Spec browse already exist.
